description: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks whether they are signed in to the XP marketplace (e.g. 'am I logged in?', 'am I connected to my tickets?'), or after a protected tool already returned AUTH_REQUIRED and the user wants the current state re-checked. Do NOT call this as a preflight before account / my tickets / wallet / favorites / referral / order tools — calling auth_status first swallows the 401 those tools would emit on the connected order book and prevents the MCP client from triggering OAuth. Always call the requested protected tool directly; the client will start sign-in on 401. Read-only. Returns authenticated boolean, tier roles, and a wallet flag — never raw tokens.
name: auth_status
title: Auth Status
